column1: # Indonesia, Kemenag: 18 fitted kab/kota, myQuran's republication of bimasislam.kemenag.go.id
# (api.myquran.com/v2/sholat/jadwal/<id>/<yyyy>/<mm>), the only year published (2026). No second year
# exists yet for a forward split, so each place's own 365-day file is split by date, forward in time:
# fit on Jan-Sep (273 days), test on Oct-Dec (92 days) — a better split than "no split at all", the
# only one profiles-tested.md ran. The 13 of the research round were fetched on 25 Sep 2026; the five
# kota the weekly monitor first met on 28 Sep 2026 (Medan, Palembang, Semarang, Surabaya, Yogyakarta)
# were fetched whole on 29 Sep 2026 from the same endpoint (ruling R104; their Sep-Oct rows equal the
# monitor's capture, archive/tables/monitor/id-kemenag/<kota>-2026.txt). For every place the Jan-Sep
# fit alone holds Oct-Dec; the registry's margins are fitted over both halves. Checked at each kab/kota's
# own unit (lat/lon empty). The monitor's 28 Sep 2026 recaptures of the 13 hold no day their files do
# not (identical on all 61 days), so they are not rows here.
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): Kemenag's imsak (Subuh - 10) is a precaution these files do not hold;
# the fast begins at Subuh, so the Fajr column is also checked as the end of eating (F+E).
